personal.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
personal.bio: Full-stack software engineer with 3+ years of professional and freelance experience building end-to-end web applications, architecting scalable solutions, and delivering reliable, user-focused products.

currentWork.text: Currently working as a Full-Stack Developer at

skillsFootnote: Focused on dependable systems from interface to infrastructure.

points: Built the frontend and API integration layer of TIMES, a VAT-compliant e-invoicing and ERP platform, connecting a Next.js application to Go microservices for authentication, invoicing, inventory, and analytics through a unified API gateway.

Delivered live financial dashboards for sales performance, tax liability, and receivables aging, along with print-ready multilingual invoice and receipt templates that meet government EIMS requirements.
Created a unified design system with shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS, including mobile-responsive layouts that preserve the desktop experience.

Migrated approximately 100 GB of live Dynamics 365 and Leasepath data, including notes and attachments, to self-hosted SuiteCRM before the renewal deadline using a Go client built on the Dynamics Web API.
Rebuilt opportunity relationships, replaced Dynamics process emails with 13 live SuiteCRM workflows on SendGrid, and created 46 Word templates for sales proposals and funder lease packages.
Shipped a four-step public credit application portal that creates accounts, contacts, and opportunities, then notifies the assigned sales representative.
Migrated tenant and user data from Firebase and Firestore to PostgreSQL for a multi-tenant SaaS mailer platform.
Replaced direct Firestore reads with a CRM HTTP API adapter for tenant identity resolution, decoupling the service from Firestore.
Designed the PostgreSQL schema and migration scripts supporting the new data layer.
Built a VIP guestlist management platform that streamlines exclusive event applications and gives administrators one place to review, approve, and manage applicants.
Ran bulk email and SMS campaigns with SendGrid and Twilio, bringing in more than 2,000 users.
Implemented duplicate detection, priority tagging, and conflict resolution to keep applicant data clean and help administrators focus on the highest-value applicants.

projects.name: Microservice Platform
points: Built an event-driven platform with four services, asynchronous messaging, CQRS, and a separate database per service.
Implemented circuit breakers, retries, dead-letter handling, idempotent consumers, correlation IDs, and graceful shutdown.

projects.name: iGaming RTP Simulator
points: Simulated a three-reel slot machine with weighted random symbols and a configurable payout table.
Ran more than 100,000 spins while tracking total wagered and paid amounts to calculate actual RTP.
Compared simulated and theoretical RTP to demonstrate convergence over large sample sizes.
